variant.title: XV Sudoku
variant.description: An X means adjacent digits sum to 10, and a V means they sum to 5.
rule_guide.title: XV Sudoku Rules
rule_guide.item_1: Each row, column, and 3×3 box must contain no repeated digit.
rule_guide.item_2: An X mark between two adjacent cells means their digits must sum to 10.
rule_guide.item_3: A V mark between two adjacent cells means their digits must sum to 5.
